deployments_detail.use: Integrating AI into housing infrastructure to enable independent living for older residents (barrier-reduced living concepts); backed AI-in-home survey of 2,500 seniors

AI + IoT predictive maintenance for elevators: connected elevators stream sensor/status data to a central diagnostics and remote-monitoring platform; AI analyzes the data for early fault detection to reduce outages and avoid costly emergency repairs. Explicitly stated as operational, with plans to extend the same technology to heating systems. [Vonovia in-house diagnostics/monitoring platform (IoT + AI)]

Digital remote monitoring / diagnostics platform for elevators that makes downtime and technical status visible at any time to prevent malfunctions (production rollout announcement building on the earlier predictive-maintenance work). [Vonovia (in-house platform)]

Self-learning (AI) energy management system for a 1,400-apartment neighborhood (Bochum-Weitmar) that decides in real time where locally generated energy should go — EV charging stations, household electricity, or heating — integrating PV, heat pumps, fuel cells and hydrogen production. Under construction / research deployment. [Vonovia with Fraunhofer Society; €6.2m NRW state funding]

Vonovia Proptech venture studio exploring and building companies applying frontier tech — generative AI, digital twins, material science — to affordable/climate-neutral housing; portfolio includes 'Built AI' (AI-enabled analysis & valuation for real estate). [Founders Factory (Vonovia Proptech Studio partnership)]

AI solution for transfer-pricing (TP) compliance documentation: automates the manual, repetitive TP documentation process using classical + AI technologies on a modular platform operated inside Vonovia's IT infrastructure. Moved from proof-of-concept into implementation/production. [KPMG (innovation partnership); runs in Vonovia IT infrastructure (Azure-based approach referenced)]

Service chat with an AI assistant (KI-Assistent) in the 'Mein Vonovia' tenant app, handling customer-service interactions (contracts, messages, documents, damage reports) for tenants. Listed as a live channel on Vonovia's official customer-service page. [Vonovia 'Mein Vonovia' app (app built with Appsfactory)]

'Image Insight' computer-vision project to recognize damages/appliances in tenants' damage reports to minimize delays and enhance customer support. Because no labeled/scrapable data was permitted, NILG.AI used generative AI to create synthetic training data (appliance pictures and tenant complaint emails). [NILG.AI (computer vision + generative AI for synthetic data)]

'Flat-Finder' AI recommender system that matches prospective tenants to Vonovia's residential units based on personal preferences (KI-gestützte individuelle Wohnungsvorschläge). Built as a challenge/pilot recommender over ~400,000 units across DE/SE/AT; presented as a Vonovia innovation product. [NILG.AI (recommender system built via DataHub Ruhr open-innovation collaboration)]
